plugin.description: Mutes and unmutes the microphone, and shows on the key whether it is currently muted.
plugin.requirements: PulseAudio or PipeWire with the PulseAudio interface.

ToggleMute.description: Toggles the microphone between muted and unmuted. The key shows the current state by itself: a red background and a crossed out microphone while muted.

all.description: Mute every microphone instead of a single one. Set this to true and leave device out unless a specific microphone is meant.

device.description: The microphone to mute, by its PulseAudio device nickname. Ignored when all is true; without either of them the action does nothing.
